content: Yaheiya xili jienliele iresan kunlade kieliewo, "Du mogheini zhunzhughala, kien tande jianlai ireku Hudai hokukuse anda shidane giezhi kieliewo?
Ta geizhen giesanne giekughala zhenmin gie. Iburaheimushi bijienyi xienren wo giezhi ta zhughedene bu sumula. Bi tande kielieye, Huda ene tashilani Iburaheimuni houdei gholugha shidane.
Ede sugiei mutun genzide teiwo. Gou alima ulie souku mutunlani man chizhidene khande teine."
Kunla asawo, "Qingiese bijien matugiene?"
Yaheiya kieliewo, "Ghua jien bisan kunla jien witu kunlade ogi. Ijiewuni bisan kunla ye qingiezhi gie."
Shui shanjisan kunlaye xili giele iredene asawo, "Loushi, bijien matugiese gouwo?"
Yaheiya kieliewo, "Zhao hhe shuzighala kere, hhense olon bu kere."
Pse niezhan buduilaye asawo, "Bijien matugiese gou wo?" Yaheiya kieliewo, "Kunlani ayighazhi baer bu kere. Kunlai hu bu zha. Tande ogisan gunzi kuzho gie."
Hhe shihoude kunla man Mexihani panjizho. Ingiese kunla zhughedene sumulazhi Yaheiyashi Mexiha wo giezho.
Yaheiya hhelade kieliewo, "Bi usughala tai xili gieghazhoma, mase khuina irechen kun mase nenli fugie wo. Bi hhende mahei deizi andaghaseye pei dane. Hhe Shenlin, khanghala tai xili gieghane.
Hhe khadene baqi bareizhi tughonni boudeii baqiliezhi agidene cankude zhonlone. Arasunlai ulie xinieku khande teine."
Yaheiya pse olon kielienghala kunlade gouxioxini jianjizhi kieliewo.
Melieshida Hherode on jiune bierei Xilojini agiwo. Hhe melieshidase huaishi olon giewo. Yaheiya hheni kheilasenu
pse nie huaishi giezhi Yaheiyani bafanzide khawo.
Ersa Xilini Jienliezho
Yaheiya kunlai xili gieghakude Ersaiye hhantu gieghawo. Ersa onxian giekude asiman keidene
Shenlin hhei jiere bouzhewo. Yanzini ghoghochenyi xianli. Ingiedene asiman jierese shenqi irezhi kieliewo, "Chishi bi oresan kewon wo. Bi chade xiqi wo."
